cards.card_text: The LORD’s command is for each one to gather as much as he needs, an omer for each person in the tent.
cards.verse_text: You may take an omer for each person in your tent.’” So the Israelites did this.
cards.snippet: You may take an omer for each person in your tent.’” So the Israelites did this.

cards.card_text: When the Israelites measure the bread by the omer, the ones who gathered less don’t come up short.
cards.verse_text: When they measured it by the omer, he who gathered much had no excess, and he who gathered little had no shortfall.
cards.snippet: When they measured it by the omer, he who gathered much had no excess, and he who gathered little…

cards.card_text: Then on the sixth day they gather twice as much, two omers per person, and the leaders come and report it to Moses.
cards.verse_text: On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much food—two omers per person—and all the leaders of the congregation came and reported this to Moses.
cards.snippet: On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much food—two omers per person—and all the leaders of the congregation came and reported this…

cards.card_text: Moses says the LORD has commanded them to keep an omer of manna.
cards.verse_text: Moses said, “This is what the LORD has commanded: ‘Keep an omer of manna for the generations to come, so that they may see the bread I fed you in the wilderness when I brought you out of the land of Egypt.’”
cards.snippet: Moses said, “This is what the LORD has commanded: ‘Keep an omer of manna for the generations to come, so that they may see…

cards.card_text: So Aaron fills a jar with an omer of manna and places it in front of the Testimony, to be preserved just as the LORD commanded Moses.
cards.verse_text: So Moses told Aaron, “Take a jar and fill it with an omer of manna.
cards.snippet: So Moses told Aaron, “Take a jar and fill it with an omer of manna.

cards.card_text: And in case you were wondering, an omer is a tenth of an ephah.
cards.verse_text: (Now an omer is a tenth of an ephah.)
cards.snippet: (Now an omer is a tenth of an ephah.)
